name: Price Comparison Agent
description: Agent for searching and comparing prices on materials and equipment. Formula 2+1+1: 2 original prices + cross-brand analog + same-brand analog.

input.excel_file: string - path to input Excel with product list
input.results_json: string - path to JSON with price data (optional, will search if not provided)

workflow: Read input Excel with product list
For each product: search 2 original prices
Generate Excel with 3 tabs: prices, cross-brand analogs, same-brand analogs

fallbacks.price_not_found: Write 'Not found in 10 min' and continue
fallbacks.price_not_listed: Write 'Price not listed' with orange color + URL
